type.description: Starts when its address is called.

enabled.description: Whether it starts anything. Default true. Turn it off to pause it without deleting it.

tags.description: CEL expressions over `trigger`, what the trigger was given. Each gives one tag for the run it starts, such as `'order:' + string(trigger.id)`. A tag is up to 64 characters of a-z, 0-9 and _.:-; an expression that fails or gives anything else is left out.

source.description: A trigger source to hand each request or each tick to first. What it returns is what starts the script or flow.

input.description: What the script or flow is given. `body` is the parsed body alone, and the default. `request` is `{ body, headers, rawBody, query, method }`, for a sender whose headers matter.

verify.description: Checks that a request was signed with a shared secret before anything starts. A request that fails is answered 401. Covers senders that put an HMAC of the body in a header, such as GitHub, Shopify and Slack.

scheme.description: The way the signature is made: HMAC with SHA-256, or with SHA-1.

header.description: The header the signature is sent in.

secret.description: The name of the workspace secret that holds the shared secret.

encoding.description: How the signature is written. Default hex.

prefix.description: Text before the signature in the header, such as `sha256=`.

signed.description: What was signed, with `{body}` for the raw body and `{timestamp}` for the timestamp header. Default `{body}`. Slack signs `v0:{timestamp}:{body}`.

timestampHeader.description: A header holding when the request was sent, in seconds since 1970.

toleranceSeconds.description: How old a request may be, by its timestamp header. Default 300.

type.description: Starts when an event is published.

filter.description: CEL over `event`. The script runs only when it is true.

enabled.description: Whether it starts anything. Default true. Turn it off to pause it without deleting it.

tags.description: CEL expressions over `trigger`, what the trigger was given. Each gives one tag for the run it starts, such as `'order:' + string(trigger.id)`. A tag is up to 64 characters of a-z, 0-9 and _.:-; an expression that fails or gives anything else is left out.

type.description: Starts when someone sends a form the platform serves.

enabled.description: Whether it starts anything. Default true. Turn it off to pause it without deleting it.

title.description: The heading of the form's page.

description.description: What is said under the heading, to whoever fills the form in.

fields.description: What the form asks, in order. Each answer is a field of the input.

name.description: The key the value has in the input.

label.description: What the field is called on the page.

type.description: What kind of answer it takes: a line of text, several lines, an email address, a number, a date, one of a list or a checkbox.

required.description: Whether the form can be sent with it empty.

help.description: A line under the field that says what to put in it.

submitLabel.description: What the button that sends the form says.

success.description: What is shown once the form was sent.

access.description: Who may send the form. `signed_in` asks for a sign-in to the tenant's portal first. Default `anyone`.
